description: Predicting and quantifying the effect of variations in long-term water demand on micro-hydropower energy recovery in water supply networks is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Lucy Corcoran, Aonghus McNabola. To improve water supply energy efficiency micro-hydropower turbines can be installed within networks at locations of excess pressure. However, future changes in flow rates and pressures at these locations could render an installed turbine unsuitable. Coverage: Ireland and the UK. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1286273 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
